svg.title: The tree of 85 breast tissue samples and its six subtypes
svg.desc: Schematic of Sorlie et al., PNAS 98:10869 (2001), Fig. 1A. A dendrogram of 85 samples, traced from the paper's figure, with six colored subtrees named underneath, left to right: basal-like (red, 14 samples), ERBB2+ (pink, 11), normal breast-like (green, 13), luminal subtype C (light blue, 10), luminal subtype B (yellow, 5) and luminal subtype A (dark blue, 32). Sample names and the paper's color scale are omitted.
